Hi Tom / Elena —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our MAP (attached) I pulled together a short pricing/budget checkpoint so we can lock the close plan and surface any internal approval blockers. Key asks in this note: budget band confirmation, whether you need credits for the POC, and an expected commit sizing (monthly units or $).

Attachments: CortexHealth_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with timeline & owners), Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (draft SOW for preliminary review)

Snapshot: 
- Evaluation timeline: POC runs 9/6–9/20, exec decision target 9/15 (per our last call)
- Recommended commit for production POC: option A = 200k tokens/month (~$6k/mo), option B = 500k tokens/month (~$14k/mo).

As we discussed, pricing gate items: discount ask, POC credits, commit sizing, and routing for internal approvals. Could you confirm by EOD Monday 9/6:
1) Budget band (range OK)
2) Whether you require credits for production POC and if so approximate amount ($)
3) Preferred commit option (A or B) or a custom target

If there are procurement requirements / PO templates we should know about, please attach. We can escalate a credit/discount request to pricing if needed — Ben is on cc for approvals path.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a brief internal note to align pricing committee if you indicate a discount request.

Best,

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below so we can prepare procurement: 

1) Budget band: we have an initial budget window of $20k–$40k for Q4 evaluation + initial pilot. We could expand on strong ROI signals but need to start conservative.
2) Credits: yes — Engineering asked for credits to run the full production POC (~2 weeks of heavy traffic). Ballpark: $5k–$8k in usage credits would make the POC feasible without blowing our budget.
3) Commit sizing: leaning to option B if we can get credits; otherwise Option A and a short ramp. Our finance lead will require a three-line justification (SaaS cost, integration hours, expected token/month).

Procurement: we need a PO-ready SOW and a vendor W-9. I attached our PO template (PO_template_CortexHealth.docx). Legal will review any terms that materially change data residency or retention.

Decision timing: we are aiming to confirm a pilot commitment by 9/15 but might need an extra week if legal pushes back.

Thanks Tom — looped in to confirm internal approval path. A few quick notes from pricing side: 

- Standard options we can route:
  • Option 1 (Standard): no discount, flexible monthly with $/token pricing.
  • Option 2 (Commit): 12-month commit with 10% discount and reserved capacity (recommended for sustained usage).
  • Option 3 (Pilot + Ramp): 3-month pilot commit with 15% discount and up-to $10k in usage credits (requires pricing committee sign-off).

- Approvals: pricing@redwood.com can approve up to 15% discount and up to $10k credits for strategic pilots; anything beyond that needs a pricing committee review next Wednesday (9/8). Legal will need to review SOW redlines — Marissa, please share any required CLINs or data residency clauses.

- Ask for the Cortex team: can you confirm expected ARR if you went with the Commit (12 months)? Even a scoping number (e.g., $75–150k ARR) helps expedite committee approval. Also confirm whether Cortex needs custom IP/data handling clauses; that materially affects legal timeline.

I’ve attached the SOW draft and added a redline placeholder where we typically surface credits. I’ll prep a short memo for the pricing committee if Cortex confirms the 15% pilot ask + $8k credits.
